name: tag
title: Tag
description: One short word that says what state a row is in, such as Joined, Public or Private. Three tones: neutral, positive and accent. It reads its colours from roles every theme already sets, so any theme draws it. It is a word, not a control, and it wraps rather than truncating.
docs: Pass label for the word and tone for how much it stands out: neutral (default), positive or accent. Put it in a Row's value, a Leaderboard entry or any list. To recolour every tone, set --gs-tag-fill and --gs-tag-ink on a scope. Style the label part with data-gs-scope="tag".
